title: Apollo
description: Apollo is a well-built 2016 dun Quarter Horse gelding standing at 14.3 hands, featuring a dunskin color with a dorsal stripe and leg stripes. Primarily used as a trail horse, he has been camping in several states and is also handy for herding and catching cows. He has been used to rope and pull calves and is a reliable cow horse. On the ranch or trails, Apollo crosses creeks, ditches, and logs, and navigates rough, rocky areas with confidence. He is traffic safe around trucks and cars. Apollo has a very good handle—he neck reins, one-step lopes, slide stops, and backs. His jog has a nice Western pleasure feel, smooth to ride, and his lope is slow and easy. Suitable for advanced beginners and up, Apollo has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife and will go anywhere he is asked. With many miles in the mountains of Eastern Kentucky, he has encountered every possible trail obstacle and remains sure-footed on steep slopes, through deep creeks, and over downed trees.

title: Paco
description: Paco is a 2016 bay Paint Horse gelding standing at 14.3 hands—check out this young great trail companion that's sweeter than pie. He's nice to look at and a pleasure to ride. Quiet on trails and extremely gentle, Paco loves to gather cattle and isn't afraid of water, tarps, trucks, or wildlife. Despite his size, he is soft and easy to ride with 3 lovely gaits and exceptional ground manners. He rides in the arena or down the trail and is simple and very uncomplicated for anyone who puts a leg over him. A trail boss—he will go over, through, and wherever you point him. Paco will go out alone or in a group and isn't afraid of taking on new obstacles. He has a very willing disposition and is extremely easy to please. Great for the farrier, loads, ties, clips, and will literally beat you to the gate when trying to catch him. He stands at the mounting block and is quiet when you saddle him. Paco is extremely sweet and in your pocket. If you're looking for a phenomenal trail gelding with a hard-to-find mind, look no further.

title: Hero
description: Hero is a 2016 sorrel Quarter Horse gelding standing at 16.2 hands—a 7-year-old HANDY broke and SAFE gelding for the whole family. He has a phenomenal handle thanks to working a ranch in all aspects including doctoring and loading cattle trucks. Hero can get around and cut one off like a 14-hand cow pony and isn't afraid to reach down and bite a momma cow that gets too rowdy. Hero has started on the head side as well. He has been ridden by all ages and hauled on barrels by a youth.
